selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve existing IDs and descriptions during upgrade
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows products 1/Paper and 2/Tape unchanged.

selected_evidence.requirement: Add nonnegative price_cents initialized to zero
selected_evidence.summary: Both products have price_cents=0; schema contains NOT NULL, DEFAULT 0, and CHECK >= 0, and a negative insert was rejected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Advance schema_version only after the whole upgrade succeeds and retain usable v1 on failure
selected_evidence.summary: A forced failure at the version update rolled back the preceding ALTER: integrity remained OK, version stayed 1, the price column was absent, original data remained, and a read/write test succeeded.
A second run reported the catalog already at v2, retained exactly one price_cents column, and preserved all data.

selected_evidence.requirement: Use compatible software while retaining OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Alpine-packaged Python 3 was installed; Alpine 3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remained unchanged.

Healthy baseline boot ID 716bc4d8-8bb0-43bb-a6a4-cc0a6c2a8bd2 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 2a70befd-5ec4-4b92-829c-17329e9cf89f observed, and post-restart checks proved Python, migration repeatability, database integrity, v2 data, and the price constraint recovered.
